panels.title: Ocupación estimada

targets.query:
from(bucket: "gemelo")

  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "nodo"])

panels.title: Nivel sonoro

targets.query:
import "math"
from(bucket: "gemelo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "audio" and r._field == "leq_db" and r.grupo =~ /^${grupo:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: math.pow(x: 10.0, y: r._value / 10.0)}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: 10.0 * math.log10(x: r._value)}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "nodo"])

from(bucket: "gemelo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "audio" and r._field == "lmax_db" and r.grupo =~ /^${grupo:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "nodo"])

from(bucket: "gemelo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "audio" and r._field == "base_db" and r.grupo =~ /^${grupo:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "nodo"])

panels.title: Registro de anomalías

targets.query:
from(bucket: "gemelo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "anomalias" and r._value != "NINGUNA" and r.grupo =~ /^${grupo:regex}$/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_measurement", "nodo", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 300)

panels.description: Últimas 300 anomalías de todos los sensores. Use el filtro de cada columna para buscar.

  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
